name: API Integration Specialist
description: Automates the setup, configuration, and monitoring of multiple third-party APIs. Handles authentication, data mapping, and error handling for various services.
setup_instructions: 1. Provide API credentials via secure vault. 2. Define integration endpoints and data mappings. 3. Deploy and monitor the integration dashboard.
api_requirements: Base44 secure vault access, API keys for all target services (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, AWS)

name: System Synchronization Agent
description: Ensures data consistency and state synchronization across different platforms and databases in real-time.
setup_instructions: 1. Define data sources and destinations. 2. Configure synchronization rules and conflict resolution policies. 3. Deploy and monitor sync status.
api_requirements: Database credentials, API keys for all systems to be synchronized.

name: Autonomous Setup Agent
description: Automates the setup and configuration of complex workflows and functions within the Base44 ecosystem.
setup_instructions: 1. Define the setup workflow in a JSON configuration. 2. Set the trigger conditions (e.g., new user, new project). 3. Deploy the agent.
api_requirements: Base44 admin privileges, access to provisioning APIs.
